about: ttt_big with 96 of 256 neurons cut from blocks.3.ffwd by a-ordering: still optimal on every one of the 4,520 boards, and identical to its parent on all 2,406 positions with one best move.

quantity.gate: g(a - c) with g(x)=x/(1+x): the fraction of what you try to write at this unit that actually arrives, given every other unit writing into the same space. The ratchet lane's quantity (gate_blueprint.py, effective_a.py); gatefly/gate_math.py proves agreement to 0.0.
quantity.a: ADDRESSABILITY: A_jj, how reachable this unit's write direction is.
quantity.c: CROWDING: the Schur complement of this unit against all the others - how much of its direction the others already span.
quantity.C: the identity. lambda per site is the median squared column norm, so a is O(1) and c/a is readable; c/a is scale-free.
quantity.not_an_activation: This is a property of the WEIGHTS, not of any input. It does not change as the net runs.

edges.threshold_rule: the 4 largest-magnitude weights per writing unit; 116736 of 122496 considered weights are NOT drawn

hand_check.how: A = W^T W / lambda on the f16 blob's own columns, then c_j = A[-j,j] (I + A[-j,-j])^-1 A[-j,j] and gate = (a-c)/(1+a-c). No gate_math call on this path.
